title: 418 Locks Netflix Release Date
text:
418 Locks Netflix Release Date | Telugu Filmnagar తెలుగు 418 Locks Netflix Release Date
 Published: 2026-11-17
 The upcoming Telugu film  418 is gearing up for its digital premiere, with Netflix announcing November 20 as its streaming date. Presented by filmmaker Prashanth Neel, the horror thriller will be available in five languages, including Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam, allowing it to reach audiences across different regions. 
 Written and directed by Kirtan Nadagouda,  418 is produced by Naveen Yerneni and Y Ravi Shankar under the Mythri Movie Makers banner. The project has drawn attention with Prashanth Neel presenting the film, bringing another interesting title from the production house to the streaming space. 
 The film features Chaithra J Achar, Ramesh Indira, Surya Raj Veerabathini and Preethi Pagadala, among others. The technical team includes cinematographer Dinesh Divakaran, music composer Venky GG and editor Akul Avinash. 
 With its supernatural thriller backdrop and an ensemble cast,  418 brings a different genre offering to the OTT lineup. The film's digital release in five languages is expected to help it connect with a wider audience beyond its theatrical reach. 
 As the Netflix premiere approaches, viewers can get ready to experience  418 from November 20. The film adds to the platform's upcoming Indian content lineup and brings another Telugu thriller to streaming audiences.
